originalTitle: Wall Street rallies, Dow closes at record on Iran talks optimism
summary: STORY: U.S. stocks kicked off August with a rally on Monday, as the Dow added about one-and-a-third percent to close at a record high, the S&P 500 climbed one-and-a-half percent and the Nasdaq added more than two percent. Communication services was the best performing of the 11 major S&P sectors, boosted by a 6% jump for Meta and a nearly 5% gain by Alphabet. Jed Ellerbroek is portfolio manager at Argent Capital Management. “Obviously, an extension from last week, in terms of the big cloud computing giants, doing well after their earnings report. And then I think we're also starting to see some semiconductor and AI data center CapEx beneficiary flow through and do well too. Nvidia, for example, is up I think a little more than 3% today. So, I guess a broad tech rally. And I think investors are becoming increasingly convinced that the return on investment from all of the CapEx spending that the big tech companies are doing has got an appealing ROI to it - both now and I think in the future, too. And so that's why we've seen those stocks rally so much here in the last three or four trading days. And that’s really an amazing contrast to just the week before.”' :: Amazon Sticking with tech, shares of Amazon gained about four-and-a-half percent as the company's market cap surpassed $3 trillion for the first time after its earnings results last week. And shares of SpaceX, which will report its first quarterly results on Tuesday, jumped more than five-and-half percent. The stock has been trading below its $135 issue price for nearly three weeks after its debut in mid-June. Meanwhile, crude prices settled down about 5% after President Donald Trump said on Sunday that talks with Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz would take place on Monday, though Iran disputed that talks were planned. Lower oil prices helped push the S&P 500 Energy sector down more than one percent, making it the worst performing sector of Monday's session.

chineseTitle: 华尔街股市上涨，道指因伊朗谈判乐观情绪收盘创历史新高
chineseSummary: 故事：美国股市周一以反弹拉开了 8 月份的序幕，道琼斯指数上涨约三分之一，收于历史新高，标准普尔 500 指数上涨 1.5%，纳斯达克指数上涨超过 2%。通信服务是标准普尔 11 个主要板块中表现最好的，Meta 上涨 6%，Alphabet 上涨近 5%。 Jed Ellerbroek 是 Argent Capital Management 的投资组合经理。 “显然，大型云计算巨头在发布财报后表现良好，这是上周的延续。然后我认为我们也开始看到一些半导体和人工智能数据中心资本支出受益者流入并表现良好。例如，英伟达的股价今天上涨了 3% 多一点。所以，我猜科技股将出现广泛的反弹。而且我认为投资者越来越相信大型科技公司正在进行的所有资本支出支出的投资回报已经得到了回报。”投资回报率颇具吸引力——无论是现在还是未来。这就是为什么我们在过去三四个交易日看到这些股票大幅上涨，这与前一周形成了鲜明对比。” 亚马逊 坚持科技股，亚马逊股价在上周发布财报后首次突破 3 万亿美元，股价上涨了约 4 个百分点。 SpaceX 将于周二公布第一季度业绩，其股价上涨超过百分之五半。自 6 月中旬上市以来，该股近三周的交易价格一直低于 135 美元的发行价。与此同时，在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周日表示将于周一与伊朗就重新开放霍尔木兹海峡进行谈判后，原油价格下跌约 5%，尽管伊朗否认谈判已结束。
